# Menu

Dropdown of actions for an object (row actions, user menu).

`KenosUI.Menu` · Overlays

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Menu trigger={…} items={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Menu" trigger="{{…}}" items="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Dropdown menu in the top layer (never clipped, works inside Dialog/Drawer), flips up near the bottom edge. Arrow keys, Home/End, Esc, click outside.

## Props (MenuProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `trigger` * | `React.ReactElement` | A Button / IconButton; it gets onClick + aria attributes. |
| `items` * | `MenuItem[]` |  |
| `placement` | `"bottom-start" \| "bottom-end"` |  |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` |  |
